text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the absence of Mr. C.B., the public's 
attention turned to Symboli Rudolf—a 
highly anticipated rising star competing 
in the Classic generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll win and turn this whole mood 
around. With fierce resolve, Katsuragi Ace 
headed for the Osaka Hai!
